text:
maria-ps: ACME legal sent back the security questionnaire with two non-negotiables: 1) no outbound telemetry by default, 2) a custom clause about offline data retention. They also want a clear rollback window for the onprem POC. Can eng advise on packaging / upgrade cadence constraints?

devon-sales: Thanks. They're asking for a monthly security patch cadence + an emergency hotfix path. Is that feasible for sealed bundles?

alek-eng: Short answer: yes, with caveats. We can produce signed delta bundles monthly and do ad-hoc signed hotfixes. Need to align on transfer method (sneakernet vs SFTP) and key custody for signing.

sophie-security: Telemetry must be opt-out. We can build a compile-time flag to disable telemetry, but legal also wants a signed attestation that customer cannot be forced to re-enable it. Also: they want HSM-backed key custody for signing.

maria-ps: HSM custody — they insist on split custody and zero external access. How much extra lead time to support their HSM?

alek-eng: If they provide an HSM/public signing endpoint, integration + test vectors is ~2-3 weeks. If they want us to sign and hand over signed bundles, we need to provide a full chain-of-custody (signed manifest + transfer logs).

devon-sales: For chain-of-custody, do we provide SBOM + signed checksum + transfer manifest? They'll need that for audits.

alek-eng: Yes — plan is: include CycloneDX SBOM, sha256 sums, and a signed manifest.json. Example check we will document:
```
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle-v1.2.0.tar.gz
# compare output to manifest.signature (verified with our public key)
```
We'll also include a delta-apply script that writes an 'applied-patch' ledger entry so they can prove what was applied and when.

sophie-security: They also asked for rollback guarantees if a patch breaks models or runtime. What's realistic?

alek-eng: Rollback plan we can commit to in the POC runbook: for every release we ship a pinned snapshot. Steps:
1) stop service
2) apply previous signed bundle
3) restart runtime with --model-snapshot=<id>
We can script/automate this. Note: rollback time depends on model size and KV cache warming. Expect ~10-30 minutes for a typical 2-4 GPU node POC. Larger fleets take longer.

maria-ps: They want upgrades only in a business-hours window. Do we support scheduled activations?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: You can schedule package activations via the offline-operator CLI:
`offline-operator apply --bundle manifest.json --window "2026-04-05T01:00:00Z/2026-04-05T03:00:00Z"` :white_check_mark:

devon-sales: Pricing note: customer wants to cap monthly updates in the contract (no more than 2 major revs + emergency patches). We need to confirm engineering limits and any per-signed-artifact fees.

alek-eng: We can align: major revs quarterly, monthly security deltas, emergency patches as-needed but triaged. For sealed/onprem deployments we can either include a number of signed artifacts in the support tier or charge per additional signed artifact. Will propose options.

sophie-security: Also include: signed audit log export (sha'd) and a signed attestation that telemetry is disabled. Legal will ask for both in the contract.

maria-ps: OK, next steps: I'll send them a one-page runbook + sample signed manifest + support/pricing bullets. Alek — can you produce a sample manifest + delta apply script and a short rollback playbook by EOD Friday?

alek-eng: Yes. I'll push a sample to the POC repo and tag `acme-offline-samples`. Expect a PR with test vectors and sample signatures by Friday EOD.

devon-sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll prep the contract clause options and loop in legal.
